# Capability lineage and current Firefly maintenance

The write-expense-report capability and the retained four-column reference descend from the Playa-Cyrene/Cyrene-Agent contribution (also written Playa-0v0/Cyrene-Agent; both names resolve to the same repository) recorded at `be1c6824f4add5efc85eca377eadf7b010301477`. The later revision `734bfeeab97b0cdaf5a29ee8fd8f0d61efb88948` contains the files and the applicable upstream MIT license; the introduction commit predates that license. The existing provenance also records frontmatter history at `9a13a72bae5b0afab0d60036f1a0601be7ed9959` and `6cb6c6660200226e561128a6b959b1515edcd3c8`.

Re-authored on 2026-10-13: the operational body, the helper-contract reference and the standard-library prepare-report.mjs were rewritten against the current query_expense, write_excel and permission-policy implementations. Compatibility is kept deliberately: the four-argument helper CLI, its output keys and error prefixes, and the tool names. A line comparison with the imported snapshot finds 18% of non-blank lines shared in SKILL.md and 41% in column-spec.md (a column contract table, retained for compatibility); the helper files did not exist in the snapshot. This is current workflow maintenance, not a claim that the capability, metadata or column reference originated wholly in Firefly, and not a claim of byte identity with an upstream release.

Preserve the existing distributed `../../LICENSE-NOTICES.md`, `../../license-provenance.json`, and the complete `../../licenses/upstream-contributions-MIT.txt`, including all original author and copyright notices. Historical matching hashes in provenance describe the recorded inherited files, not the current bodies. `skills-manifest.json` and `license-provenance.json.currentDistribution` identify the maintained members by hash. Node and any runtime workbook libraries retain their own licenses; this notice grants no additional permissions or redistribution rights.
